title: Tiffani Bova LinkedIn Live with Eric Ries — 'Why Good Companies Become Corrupt (Without Anyone Breaking the Rules)'
summary: Tiffani Bova — 2x WSJ bestselling author, Top 50 Business Thinker, and Chief Strategy & Research Officer at The Futurum Group — hosts Eric for a LinkedIn Live conversation on Incorruptible, framed around why successful organizations often drift from their original purpose.
blockquote: We explore why organizations often drift from their original purpose—not because of bad people, but because of incentives, systems, and metrics that unintentionally reward the wrong behaviors. We also discuss how leaders can build organizations that remain innovative, customer-focused, and mission-driven as they grow.
